name: example
_generateButton: Must match what the UI shows, verbatim and in its own language
_generateTimeoutSec: How long to wait for the result. Large grids take a while.
_controls: Applied in order before generating. Labels and placeholders are matched against the real UI, so copy them exactly as they appear there.
_matrix: Optional, only for flow_batch_generate: cartesian product. Values here override the ones in controls with the same label.
